calls.reason: RoboPAIR and RoboHarm demonstrate robot hazards, while RoboGuard shows safeguards can reduce them. None establishes greater risk than home assistants that also control devices.
Marcus explicitly offers a tentative opinion. Amazon's cloud-capacity account and Fortune's reporting on later resource shortages do not identify Alexa's principal barrier in November 2022.

Code as Policies and SayCan demonstrate working action systems with substantial limitations. Their results do not isolate sentence interpretation or establish the broader claim that no reliable method was known.
Amazon describes conversational Alexa+, and Consumer Reports records successes alongside bugs. Neither measures whether conversation raised users' expectations beyond what Alexa could mostly deliver.

Amazon reports tens of millions of participants, and Consumer Reports demonstrates useful home control with bugs. Population-wide reliability remains unclear, and the predicted delay has no definite duration.
